This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every six 
months as indicated
by M6 in the title block.
The pumps function: transferring Mazout from tank to gun and transfer solar from tank to igniter.

Mokhtar Abdel Latef general director, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. 
Samir Abd El-Gelil, approved by eng. Mokhter Abd El Latif Abu Soltan power 
station head sector, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection 
& quality control head sector.
